basic_profile.bio: Avid car enthusiast living in Wellington, New Zealand. I've been on Reddit for the better part of a decade, sharing tips and tricks on car maintenance and restoration. When I'm not tinkering with my Subaru, you can find me browsing through conspiracy theories or watching cat videos. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my passion for cars and gardening. I'm in a long-term relationship and we share our home with two mischievous cats. My typical online hours are late evenings, when I unwind after a day of work and projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, which I studied at university, and I've always had a passion for cars, learning through hands-on experience and community forums. My interest in hydroponics is more recent, sparked by a desire to grow my own vegetables sustainably.
